problem_type: Domain capability disappearance during runtime replacement
symptom: The lane model cannot propose timeline edits, control production tasks, inspect media, export or delete canvas nodes that the old Agent exposes.
direct_cause: The internal shared tool profile contains only the initial document/canvas/timeline-read slice.
class_root: The tool profile did not distinguish initial tools from deferred domain tools, so its fixed budget silently became the capability ceiling.
affected_population: Media inspection, export and destructive canvas requests

external_sources.purpose: The official recursive person schema demonstrates local $ref for recursive JSON values; keep this standard shape through the existing publisher.

invariants: The initial tool budget remains twelve while retained domain tools are explicitly deferred.
Every mutation uses the existing domain adapter and approved action identity.
Destructive canvas and export success requires a correlated committed receipt.
generality_proof: All deferred tools derive from capability-owned schemas and pass through one lifecycle dispatcher; all prepared writes require a durable approval before a single execution.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Collect capability-owned initial and deferred descriptors.
Bind existing domain adapters to durable approval and receipt verification.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Prepared revision-bound writes are consumed through the shared lane lifecycle.
Export writes use the same approval lifecycle and committed receipt correlation.
Preserve recursive local references via the existing converter override; official recursive person fixture and actual pi validation cover nested JSON.

recurrence.reason: Every request for a domain outside the initial slice loses its tools after cutover.
same_class_scan: Compared agentToolCatalog groups and agentChatPolicy production projection with modelFacingToolRegistry.
Read timeline, production, generation, phase4 and canvas-delete transport adapters.

prevention.invariant: A prepared mutation cannot execute without a durable matching approval and cannot consume it twice.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing, cancelled, stale or uncorrelated authority produces a tool failure before execution/success.
prevention.strategy: Keep all retained schemas in shared capability owners and route each deferred tool through the existing adapter.

legacy_paths.rationale: Move descriptor ownership into shared capabilities and update all consumers directly; no re-export.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The work reuses existing domain adapters and current pi deferred-tool integration; no dependency change.

migration: No saved state is rewritten by tool registration; legacy conversation migration remains the separate stage 4 step.
residual_risks: Root agent must wire the returned groups and adapters into the real Desktop lane and verify Electron journeys.
Full cumulative domain+coding+request schema budget remains above10000 after safe metadata compression; do not treat the initial+coding budget matrix as whole-menu proof.

invariant_owner_layer.why: This is the common lane boundary immediately before existing domain executors.
